cut: D: percentile among the trailing 252 trading days incl. today (min 126), split at 1/3, 2/3
execution: realistic = next close, 5 bp + 2 bp; excess of DTB3
what: A8: sum |dw| at month-end targets split into its sources; per year = parts summed / years
check_max: T0 1.1e-16, T1 1.1e-16 (parts sum exactly to the change)
by_state: per_year there = mean per rebalance x 12, the rate the book would run at in that state
sample: 37 liquid US-listed ETFs as futures proxies; daily UTC-dated bars; 2020-01-02 to 2026-06-29; split-adjusted copy (DATA.md 4); dividends unadjusted unless the file says total return
